description: React component for rendering and managing dashboard tabs with drag-and-drop reordering, including hover menu and tab editing features.

classes.name: DraggableTabNode
classes.description: A React component that makes a tab node draggable and sortable using @dnd-kit.

methods.name: TabsRenderer
methods.description: Main React component that renders tabs with optional drag-and-drop reordering, hover menu, and editing capabilities.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Callback for initiating drag, sets active tab ID.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Callback for completing drag, triggers tab reorder if applicable.

methods.name: onDragCancel
methods.description: Callback for canceling drag, resets active tab ID.
